objective: Make the root's exclusions on Pi never lose the home-level config's patterns within a session, whatever fails, in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-wiring (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-root-wiring, head edc25d8).
scope: Validated (security re-review): topOf (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) is awaited at extension.ts ~780 before the Effect.all that reads the user-only config; a project-delivered malformed .git (garbage gitfile, malformed .git/config) fails it, failed() calls closedSettings(undefined, undefined), and the user's exclusions (for example web_search and web_fetch under pi-web-kit) are lifted for the root, with no notice about them. Start the user-only read first and independently of topOf and of the merged read (it needs no project path), so its result is used on every path.

Same root cause: gather sets taken.excluded = result.tools.excludeTools, so a later collection (compaction) whose reads fail replaces a user-inclusive list with the defaults'; make the session's excluded set only grow (union with the previous one). A deadline hit while the user read is still running leaves user undefined silently: when the user read did not finish, add the home-level notice.

Tests: a failing topOf with a user config setting pi-web-kit keeps web_search and web_fetch gated; a compaction collection whose reads fail keeps the earlier user-inclusive exclusions; a deadline during the user read shows the home-level notice and keeps the defaults. Fix docs/pi/extensions.md line ~10 if it claims more than the code does.
constraints: Change only the ownership paths; no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md code rules; each test must fail without its fix; do not weaken tests.
Run bunx --no-install mise run build and bunx --no-install mise run verify before reporting.

Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path. Write a diff-file (dist excluded) at /home/user/holyagent-notes/wire-a-fix2.diff.

criteria.text: The home-level config's exclusions apply when git, the merged read or the deadline fails, with tests
Within a session the root's excluded set never shrinks, with a test
